subject.title: [Bug]: Live Docs are ahead of release

question: Should docs.openclaw.ai track current main, latest stable, or latest-main docs with explicit version availability and recovery for unsupported stable-release config keys?
rationale: The mismatch is source-reproducible, but the durable fix changes docs publishing and release policy rather than a single safe implementation path.

options.title: Adopt Version-Aware Public Docs
options.body: Publish or annotate public docs so config keys are not presented as generally available before the release that accepts them.

options.title: Keep Latest Docs With Recovery
options.body: Keep docs.openclaw.ai as latest-main, but add prominent latest-only/version markers plus version-aware validation or doctor recovery for copied unsupported keys.

options.title: Defer To Bundled Docs Track
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/71301 as the broader version-matched docs path while keeping this issue focused on public docs policy.

recommendation.title: Adopt Version-Aware Public Docs
recommendation.body: Publish or annotate public docs so config keys are not presented as generally available before the release that accepts them.

likelyOwner.reason: He is tied to the current docs/config mismatch example and is the strongest owner signal for docs/release policy routing.
